title: Operations Associate, Courier Onboarding
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

At Wolt, we're building the delivery of (almost) everything - and our courier supply team is at the heart of making that happen. We operate across 30+ countries, and in Kazakhstan we're growing fast.

Our Supply Operations team owns the full courier lifecycle - from acquisition and onboarding to activation and retention. We're looking for an Operations Associate to join us in Almaty and take ownership of how we onboard couriers at scale: designing better processes, identifying where things break, and building the infrastructure that makes our onboarding consistently high quality across the South region.

What you’ll be doing

• Analyse onboarding funnel data to identify conversion bottlenecks and recommend process improvements

• Design and document workflows that improve registration-to-first delivery activation rates across Kazakhstan and South region markets

• Work cross-functionally with marketing, finance, and regional ops colleagues to align onboarding initiatives

• Track and report on key onboarding metrics, maintaining operational structure across multiple workstreams

• Use AI tools to accelerate analysis, communication, and process documentation

• Coordinate with external partners including fleet partners and onboarding vendors

Our humble expectations

• Fluent in Kazakh, Russian, and English - all three are required for this role

• Strong proficiency in Google Sheets / Excel - you're comfortable with formulas, pivot tables, and data tracking

• You actively use AI tools as part of how you work

• Fast learner with high learning agility - you pick up new tools, processes, and domain knowledge quickly and independently

• Self-sufficient - you figure things out on your own, ask the right questions, and don't wait to be told what to do

• Based in Almaty with the possibility to work four days a week from the office with one optional work from home day

What we offer

This is a role with real ownership and visibility - you'll be shaping how courier onboarding works across Kazakhstan and the broader South region, which spans Greece, Malta, Cyprus, Albania, Kosovo, Georgia, and Azerbaijan, with direct impact on supply growth in one of Wolt's active expansion markets. You'll work closely with regional and international colleagues daily, in an environment that moves fast and rewards initiative.

We also offer:

• Office in the heart of Almaty - comfortable workspace in a central location

• Voluntary health insurance for you and your family

• Work laptop and phone with a corporate plan

• Wolt employee discounts on orders

• Career growth within an international company, with daily collaboration across markets and functions

Next steps

We review applications on a rolling basis. If your profile looks like a match, you'll hear from our Talent Acquisition team to schedule an intro call. From there, the process includes a hiring manager interview and a take-home assignment followed by a presentation to the hiring team. We aim to keep the process straightforward and move quickly. 

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of a motivated team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going! Please submit your application and resume in English.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
About Us

At Alteva RCM , we're dedicated to helping healthcare providers thrive through expert revenue cycle management, strategic insight, and innovative solutions. We're always looking for passionate, driven professionals who want to make a meaningful impact, grow their careers, and be part of a collaborative team committed to excellence.

About the Role
Alteva RCM is building a dedicated quality function for a high-impact operational technology team. This is a foundational QA position, and the person in this role will help define how quality works here, not inherit a process someone else built.
You'll be embedded across a mix of Salesforce-native tools, AI-assisted workflows, and backend services, all actively in build. The work spans Salesforce sandbox environments, production validation workflows, .NET-based services, and AI-generated outputs where accuracy and consistency are important.
This is a hybrid manual and automation QA role. In the beginning, a meaningful part of the work will be hands-on manual testing, workflow validation, and release readiness checks while the automation framework is being built. Over time, the expectation is to convert repeatable testing into automated coverage so managers and operations leads are not carrying the burden of release testing.
The expectation is not just to find bugs. It is to build the systems that prevent them: test coverage, regression frameworks, automation runs, release gates, and clear release-readiness signals. This person should be trusted by both operations and development to say when something is ready to ship and when it is not.
What You'll Do

• Own test strategy and test case development across the internal product portfolio

• Design and maintain testing layers: smoke, happy path, regression, and release-readiness testing, mapped to release stages

• Set up and maintain automated test runs, including nightly checks where appropriate, to catch issues before business users do

• Build and maintain automation frameworks from scratch, with no existing framework to inherit

• Perform manual and automated testing across Salesforce sandbox environments, production validation workflows, .NET-based services, and AI tool outputs

• Own QA sign-off recommendations for releases, including clear communication of release risk when coverage is incomplete

• Build a QA process that shifts release testing out of managers' hands and into a structured QA workflow with clear test cases, ownership, and sign-off

• Document end-to-end business workflows and map test coverage to them

• Define and enforce release gates in partnership with developers and the Technology Lead

• Work directly with operations team leads to understand how workflows break in practice, not just in theory

• Investigate production issues: identify root cause, document findings, and own the follow-through to prevent recurrence

• Mentor and provide technical direction to the QA Engineer on the team

• Contribute to building a proactive quality culture where issues are caught before business users see them

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years in QA engineering with demonstrated experience in both manual and automated testing

• Experience with API testing, including REST and/or SOAP, in environments with multiple system integrations

• Proficiency in SQL for validating data accuracy across system integrations

• Comfortable with version control such as Git, including working alongside developers and managing test code

• Salesforce experience required, with comfort in sandbox-based testing and production validation support

• Strong background in building automation frameworks from scratch, not just maintaining existing ones

• Experience testing AI or ML outputs is a strong plus, especially validating non-deterministic systems

• Familiarity with .NET environments is a strong plus

• Ability to write clear, thorough test documentation that non-technical stakeholders can understand

• Strong communication skills,

Trust, credibility, and precision matter deeply to their brand - every word customers read reflects the same rigor they apply to their product.

Why does this role exist?

As the brand scales, support and self-service content can't be an afterthought - it has to be as sharp, current, and on-brand as the marketing customers see before they buy. This role exists because someone needs to own that consistency: catching outdated templates, contradictory FAQs, or missing coverage before they become escalations, and building the systems (templates, style guides, AI-assisted workflows) that let the support and content functions scale without sacrificing voice or accuracy. • Build centralized campaign messaging repositories and asset libraries to improve cross-functional collaboration.

title: [Dutch] - Voice Recording Specialist

Project Morava aims to help build more natural and intelligent voice AI systems by collecting high-quality speech data from native speakers.
In this project, participants contribute by reading and recording short, scripted prompts in Dutch . These recordings are used to train and evaluate speech recognition models, enabling voice assistants and AI systems to better understand and respond to real-world users.

• Work on your own schedule

• Participate from anywhere within Netherlands

• Record scripted prompts on your smartphone using the Appen Mobile app

You will use the Appen Mobile app on your smartphone to record 150 short, scripted voice prompts in Language. Each prompt is a brief spoken command - natural, everyday language. Simply read each prompt clearly and naturally, and you're done.
Requirements

• Must be a Native speaker of Dutch

• Must be currently residing in Netherlands

• Must be 18 years old or above

• Must have a smartphone compatible with the Appen Mobile app

Payment
Get paid for just 2 hours of work - completed entirely on your smartphone, on your own schedule. Payment is issued upon completion of a full session of 150 prompts. The quality bar is simple to hit: just follow the recording guidelines, speak clearly and naturally, and you're good to go. If assigned fewer than 150 prompts, payment is adjusted proportionally.

title: Revenue Operations Manager (m/f/d) - AI tech
description:
🎤 WHY VOIZE? BECAUSE WE'RE MORE THAN JUST A JOB!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we're looking for you to join us on this mission!

💡 YOUR MISSION: TURN GROWTH INTO A SYSTEM!

Hi, I'm Jeremy, I lead RevOps at voize. I'm hiring the person who owns sales operations as we scale: new markets, new segments, and a sales team growing fast in all of them.

As Sales Operations Manager, you build the GTM engine that carries us past €100M ARR, working in close partnership with our sales leaders, with genuinely good tooling and AI ways of working behind you. Joining at this point in our hyper-growth journey is rare: big enough that the problems are real, early enough that you shape how they get solved. What you build now compounds for years, and so does your scope.

This role is roughly 60% building new process and 40% running what exists. If you want a mature machine to optimize, this is not it. If you want to design the machine, for now and for what comes next, it is.

🚀 YOUR DAILY BUSINESS - NO TWO DAYS ARE ALIKE

- Territory, compensation & capacity. Own the global account, territory and book-of-business model. Carve books for new AEs, keep segmentation honest as we add hospitals and new geos, and build the capacity and quota model that underpins our fiscal plan.

- Forecasting. Run the forecast process end to end with our VP Sales and team leads: weekly hygiene, submit and roll-up, quarterly commit. Diagnose why deals slip, and stand the process up in the US, France and UK as those teams ramp.

- Insights the company acts on. Define the sales metrics we run on, then turn pipeline and funnel data into the analysis that steers board meetings, monthly GTM reviews and weekly deal inspection. You define what gets measured; our data and BI team build the layer underneath.

- Commercial process. Design how non-standard deals are managed at voize. You set the rules and stand the function up; you will not be the approval queue.

- Process and tool enablement. In close collaboration with sales enablement, you make sure what gets built actually gets adopted, partnering with leaders, AEs and SDRs to prioritize the work with the most impact.

- The GTM stack, built AI-first. Own the sales side of CRM and the tools around it. Automate the manual layer with Claude, n8n and whatever else earns its place, and take a real position on which tooling we buy next as we scale.

🤝 YOUR SKILLSET - WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

- 3+ years in revenue operations, sales operations or GTM strategy, at a fast-growing B2B SaaS company or in strategy/tech consulting, VC or M&A before an operating role. You have seen what breaks as a sales team scales, because you were the one who fixed it.

- Exceptional stakeholder skills. You partner with VPs and team leads as an equal, push back with evidence, and get change adopted by people who do not report to you.

- Sharp analytical instincts and deep CRM fluency. Expert in spreadsheets, comfortable reading data in a BI tool, and you have owned a HubSpot or Salesforce instance rather than just worked in one. You go deep on data enrichment and spot the patterns that keep our data model trustworthy.

- You have supported forecasting. You can talk methodology, where it broke, and what you changed. Same for a territory or quota

title: Junior Technical Integration Manager
description:
The company
Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.
That's why we built iwoca . Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.
We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.
We’re looking for a Junior Technical Integration Manager in our Partnerships team (Hybrid in London, UK).
Partners send us thousands of small businesses each month looking for finance, using our Lending API embedded in the apps those businesses already use. You’ll be the person who makes those integrations work: guiding partners’ developers through the build, fixing what breaks, and turning what partners need - and what we learn from them - into what we build next. You don’t need to arrive with extensive experience of debugging API’s, but you do need to be curious and open to learning whatever it takes to help partners.
The team
The Partnerships team puts iwoca ’s lending inside the platforms small businesses already use - banking apps, accounting software, payment providers and comparison sites- through our Lending API. Partners range from recognisable global names to one-person businesses, and each one needs its integration to work differently. The team’s job is to grow those partnerships and to keep the journey from a partner’s app to a funded loan as short as it can be. • Be the partners’ voice inside iwoca - collect what they need and push it onto the roadmap.

• Dig into integration performance data to find the problems nobody has reported yet.

• Own our public API documentation and make it the reason partners choose to build with us.

Data Analysis and Interpretation:

• Analyze and interpret complex datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights.

Data Engineering:

• Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and architectures.

Experience:

Technical Skills:

Opportunity
The VP, Clinical Service Operations owns the operational engine driving Twin Health 's virtual practice. A core part of the role is providing the Care Team Services that enrollment depends on, including but not limited to, reliably completing onboarding visits, staffing on-demand sensor support, and standing up the human backup that steps in when automated steps fail. Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide - including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more - with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

ABOUT THE TEAM

The issuing engineering team at Airwallex builds and operates core systems for card issuing, transaction processing, and settlement at global scale. The team owns mission-critical platforms that underpin Airwallex’s issuing products, with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and compliance. Key areas of ownership include:

- Cards: Customer-facing and internal systems for card lifecycle management, controls, and configuration.

- Transactions: A global, high-throughput transaction processing platform designed for low latency, high availability, and resiliency.

- Settlement: Clearance, settlement, and dispute workflows that ensure financial accuracy and scheme compliance.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As an Engineering Manager, Issuing Platform, you will lead one or more teams responsible for building and operating critical components of the issuing platform. This role combines people leadership, technical direction, and delivery ownership.

You will have direct reports and are accountable for team health, execution, and long-term technical quality. While you remain technically credible and hands-on at an architectural level, your primary focus is enabling teams to do their best work rather than being the primary individual contributor.

This role is based in Singapore.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

People leadership and team development

- Manage, coach, and grow a team of engineers through regular feedback, performance management, and career development.

- Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, quality, and continuous improvement.

- Support hiring and onboarding to scale the team sustainably.

Technical leadership and delivery

- Provide technical direction and architectural guidance for high-impact transaction processing systems.

- Partner with senior engineers and staff engineers to design scalable, resilient solutions.

- Ensure high standards for system design, code quality, testing, and operational excellence.

Platform and infrastructure ownership

- Guide the evolution of application and platform infrastructure to reduce operational overhead and improve developer productivity.

- Drive improvements across reliability, observability, security, and cost efficiency.

title: Trading Specialist- Greater Nashville, TN Area
description:
Job Description:
NOTE: Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position
To be eligible for consideration of this role, your primary residence must be located within a 90 mile radius at the time of application from the approved branch sites: Franklin and Nashville - West End.

The Role
As a Trading Specialist, you will support investors with a broad range of trading, investment, and account-related needs while helping deepen client relationships! This role involves guiding clients through market activity, processing complex securities transactions, and providing education that helps clients make informed financial decisions. By delivering personalized support through inbound client interactions, you will build trust, strengthen client loyalty, and find opportunities to connect clients with additional products and solutions. Success in this role requires a strong understanding of financial markets, trading products, industry regulations, and proficiency in breaking down complex concepts into significant client conversations.
The Expertise & Skills You Bring

• Series 7 license required

• Series 63 license or ability to obtain within 90 days

• Experience in financial services, brokerage operations, trading support, client services, or a related field.

• Knowledge of financial markets, investment products, economic trends, and industry developments.

• Understanding of securities transactions, including equities, options, mutual funds, fixed income securities, and precious metals.

• Ability to apply regulatory and policy requirements while delivering accurate and compliant support to clients.

• Ability to guide clients through trading and investment decisions with integrity and confidence.

• Consultative approach to uncovering client needs and recommending appropriate offerings, support, and solutions.

• Excellent communication and active listening skills, including the ability to explain complex investment and trading concepts in a clear and relatable manner.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy when processing transactions and handling client requests.

• Effective problem-solving, critical-thinking, and decision-making skills.

• Ability to manage several priorities and perform effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

The Team
As part of Fidelity's Client Services organization, we serve as a key connection between our clients and a diverse selection of investment products, services, and financial solutions. Our team helps investors navigate the markets by providing trading support, education, and mentorship that builds confidence and trust. We are committed to delivering outstanding service, encouraging long-term relationships, and helping clients achieve their financial goals through every market environment.
Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model
Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles.
Certifications:
Series 07 - FINRA, Series 63 - FINRA Category:
Customer Service Please be advised that Fidelity’s business is governed by the provisions of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, the Investment Company Act of 1940, ERISA, numerous state laws governing securities, investment and retirement-related financial activities and the rules and regulations of numerous self-regulatory organizations, including FINRA, among others. Those laws and regulations may restrict Fidelity from hiring and/or associating with individuals with certain Criminal Histories.

title: Working Student - Product & QA (f/m/d)
description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment.

Where 50 Billion Daily Predictions Begin

The User Experience team is the origin point of adjoe Ads. Everything the system knows about a user, every prediction the ML models make, every bid placed in an auction. It all starts with code this team ships.

The team owns two responsibilities. On the SDK side, a native Kotlin and Swift code runs inside hundreds of publisher apps. It participates in 120 million daily auctions, renders ad creatives across multiple formats, and captures the behavioral signals that power 50 billion predictions per day. The constraint that defines this work: you're executing inside someone else's app, on someone else's device, with zero tolerance for instability. Every ad impression has to feel native and fast to the user.

On the analytics side, the dashboards, investigation tools, and data frameworks that turn raw data into decisions: real-time revenue performance across active campaigns, infrastructure cost visibility, and data quality assessments. If a number matters to the business or to engineering, this team makes it accessible.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

- SDK & Mobile Game Testing: Playtest mobile games and manually test our SDK integrations to verify that ads load, display, and track correctly across target environments. You thrive in this role if you bring a technical mindset, natural curiosity about how apps work, and the ability to comfortably navigate digital tools.

- Methodical Bug Reproduction: Execute step-by-step manual testing procedures and reliably reproduce bugs to maintain core product stability. This requires high attention to detail, patience, and the focus needed to run structured, repetitive QA tasks with consistent accuracy.

- Actionable Technical Documentation: Document test findings and maintain internal testing guidelines so engineering teams can immediately act on issues. You need precise written and verbal communication skills to translate edge-case behaviors into clear, reproducible technical steps.

- Product & Market Research: Conduct directed market and product research to supply actionable data directly to product managers for decision-making. You will succeed here by following clear processes, sticking to project guidelines, and adapting as research priorities shift.

- Cross-Functional Task Rotation: Adapt to rotating projects across developers, product managers, and other stakeholders as testing needs evolve. We are looking for an enrolled university student in Germany who follows structured workflows dependable execution on cross-functional tasks.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

- Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

- Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

- Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

- Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

- Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

Tech Stack

• TypeScript, Node.js 20+, NestJS

• Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4

• PostgreSQL, TypeORM

• Modern auth systems

• REST APIs and service-layer architecture

• AI safety, moderation, and reliability concerns

• Cost, latency, fallback, and quality tradeoffs in AI features

The ideal person is a mid-senior fullstack developer who can:

• Ship clean, working features without needing heavy supervision

• Read an existing codebase and follow its patterns

• Build usable frontend experiences, not just connect APIs

• Design practical backend APIs and database models

• Debug across frontend, backend, auth, data, and deployment issues

• Write maintainable TypeScript

• Care about product quality, edge cases, and user experience

• Communicate clearly and ask good questions

• Work with urgency and ownership in a startup environment

Nice To Have

• Experience with edtech, marketplaces, SaaS, or workflow-heavy products

• Experience building admin dashboards and internal tools

• Experience with file uploads and document-heavy workflows

• Experience improving AI products in production

• Familiarity with observability, logs, background jobs, and production debugging

Working Style

This is a startup role. You should be comfortable with:

• Working closely with the founder

• Moving quickly while keeping quality high

• Taking ownership of features from idea to production

• Improving existing code instead of rewriting everything

• Prioritizing what matters most for users and the business

If you’re passionate about cutting-edge technology and thrive in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment, we want to hear from you.

Innovator: Passionate about shaping how a market thinks, not just how a product is described.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Lead the next phase of the healthcare data platform modernization

• Implement the evolution from a Microsoft SQL eXtensible Markup Language (MSSQL XML) object store toward a scalable, cloud-native AWS data architecture that enables business stakeholders and analysts to run performant, SQL-based reports and queries against healthcare data seamlessly

• Evaluate and decide the right AWS data strategy for the platform

• Evaluate and recommend the optimal AWS-native data storage and query architecture for the XML object store data, assessing options such as S3 + Athena, Aurora, DynamoDB, Redshift, and OpenSearch based on query patterns, reporting needs, cost, and scalability

• Design and build the reporting and query layer that allows business stakeholders and non-technical users to run relational SQL queries against healthcare data using familiar tooling

• Architect the migration path for XML object store data from MSSQL into the target AWS platform, defining storage formats, partitioning strategies, and data organization for optimal query performance

• Build and maintain AWS data catalog, schemas, and metadata management so that object store data is discoverable and queryable by business users

• Optimize query performance and cost across chose AWS services - partitioning, compression, file formats, and query pattern tuning

• Work directly with business stakeholders and analysts to understand reporting requirements and translate them into durable, performant data models and query patterns

• Collaborate with back-end C#/.Net engineer to ensure data flows cleanly from Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) processing pipelines into the new data layer

• Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data infrastructure using AWS-native tooling (CodePipeline, CodeBuild, and CodeDeploy)

• Apply Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK), CloudFormation, or Terraform

• Document architecture decisions, data flows, and data dictionaries clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences

Required Skills and Experience

• 8+ years’ experience in software or data engineering with a strong AWS focus

• Proven experience architecting and executing cloud data platform migrations in production enterprise or healthcare environments

• Track record of evaluating and selecting AWS data services to meet business reporting and query requirements

• Experience delivering reporting or analytics solutions that serve non-technical business users

title: DFx Engineer, Mechanical & Fluid Systems
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril's Air Dominance & Strike (AD&S) Manufacturing Engineering team is seeking a DFx Engineer to support design for manufacturability, assembly, and cost analysis across our mechanical, structural, thermal management, and fluid systems (fuel, hydraulics, pneumatics) subsystems. This role spans our full portfolio of autonomous aircraft, cruise missiles, and loitering munitions - and is an excellent opportunity for an early-career engineer to develop deep expertise in how design decisions impact producibility, supplier selection, and unit cost.
Working under the guidance of Staff and Senior DFx Engineers, you will learn to evaluate designs through the lenses of manufacturability, assembly, and cost - the three factors that determine whether hardware can be produced at rate, by a qualified supplier, at an affordable price point. You will work alongside subject matter expert (SME) manufacturing engineers and design engineers, building the technical judgment and cross-functional relationships that make DFx effective.
You will also gain hands-on exposure to contract manufacturer evaluation and qualification - visiting supplier facilities, participating in process assessments, and learning how to match supplier capabilities to production requirements. This is an inherently cross-functional role: you will work daily with supply chain, quality, operations, and program teams in addition to ME and DE. You will grow quickly here - our programs move fast, the hardware is real, and the impact of your work shows up on the production floor and in the cost model.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Support DFx analysis across mechanical, structural, thermal, and fluid systems subsystems for AD&S programs, working under the guidance of Staff and Senior DFx Engineers, with a focus on manufacturability, assembly, and cost.

• Participate in structured DFM/DFA/DFC reviews at key design milestones, learning and applying the scoring methodology to identify producibility and cost risks and recommend design changes.

• Participate in DFMEAs with cross-functional teams. Use FMEA outputs to drive design changes, inspection strategies, and control plans.

• Work with SME manufacturing engineers and design engineers to provide manufacturing and cost feedback on designs, learning to translate constraints into actionable recommendations.

• Support the evaluation and qualification of contract manufacturers - participating in facility reviews, process audits, and capability assessments under the guidance of senior team members.

• Help build and maintain should-cost models and cost-driver analyses for mechanical and fluid system assemblies.

• Help develop and maintain DFx standards, guidelines, and scorecards specific to mechanical manufacturing processes including CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, welding, brazing, composite layup and bonding, tube bending and swaging, and mechanical assembly.

• Analyze designs across key lenses - manufacturability/assembly, cost structure, adherence to specification, process capability, and technology maturity - contributing to risk assessments that inform engineering and program decisions.

• Work with supply chain to understand how DFx requirements connect to sourcing strategy and supplier

title: Remote Patient Monitor - Virtual Assistant
description:
This is a remote position.
Virtual Rockstar is hiring a full-time Remote Patient Monitor on behalf of our client - a rapidly growing home-based healthcare organization headquartered in Arkansas. This role is ideal for a compassionate, detail-oriented professional with a nursing background and strong Athena EMR experience who’s passionate about improving patient outcomes through remote care.
As the Remote Patient Monitor, you’ll be responsible for tracking patient health data, conducting outreach calls, and ensuring accurate documentation within Athena EMR. You’ll monitor key vital sign parameters, check for out-of-range readings, and coordinate with providers to ensure timely interventions when needed.
This role is a blend of clinical insight and administrative excellence - perfect for someone who understands patient care but thrives in a structured, data-driven environment.
You’ll play a key role in supporting patients receiving home visits, helping manage their ongoing health data and coordinating communication with their clinical care team.
About Our Client
Our client provides comprehensive mobile primary care and post-hospital follow-up services, specializing in supporting patients who face barriers to traditional healthcare - including seniors and individuals managing chronic conditions. Their team of medical professionals brings high-quality, personalized care directly to patients’ homes, ensuring continuity and compassion every step of the way.
The organization’s mission is to make healthcare more accessible, proactive, and human by combining hands-on home visits with modern remote patient monitoring systems.
Responsibilities
Patient Monitoring & Communication

• Review and document daily or weekly patient readings such as weight, blood pressure, and glucose levels

• Call patients to follow up on vitals, medication changes, or symptoms

• Ask guided clinical questions to assess patient condition and compliance

• Identify abnormal or out-of-range values and escalate them to the provider team

• Maintain a compassionate and professional tone with patients, primarily elderly individuals receiving home care

Data Entry & EMR Documentation

• Enter, review, and update patient data accurately within Athena EMR

• Create, modify, and maintain templates in Athena for consistent reporting and follow-up documentation

• Log all communication, notes, and observations for provider review

• Track and report trends in patient vitals to support proactive care management

Team Collaboration & Administrative Support

• Communicate with providers and medical staff using Microsoft Teams for updates and escalations

• Coordinate with the care team to ensure each patient’s remote monitoring aligns with their visit schedules

• Assist in developing workflow efficiencies and monitoring reports for quality assurance

Requirements

• Nursing background (LPN, RN, or equivalent education strongly preferred)

• Experience using Athena EMR is required

• Knowledge of normal vs. abnormal parameters for common vital signs

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills (clear, professional, and patient-friendly)

• Comfort with phone-based patient communication, particularly with elderly patients

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in documentation

• Reliable technology setup with secure internet connection suitable for HIPAA-compliant work

• Ability to work collaboratively and independently in a remote setting

Benefits

• Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

• Opportunities for professional development and growth.

• Work in a dynamic and supportive team environment.

• Make a meaningful impact by helping to build and strengthen families across the globe.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a seasoned Microservices Architect to lead the design and evolution of large-scale microservices ecosystems built on modern container platforms and cloud-native technology stacks. The role requires deep expertise in service decomposition, domain-driven design, distributed data management, and runtime concerns such as resilience, observability, and security at scale. The ideal candidate brings hands-on architectural leadership across complex transformations, with a clear point of view on when microservices are the right answer, how to evolve them safely, and how to keep the resulting estate maintainable over the long term.

• Establish CI/CD, testing, and deployment standards optimized for high-frequency, low-risk service releases.

About the Team

The Plugin Ecosystem team builds the platform and product experiences that let people extend ChatGPT and Codex. We work on plugins, skills, connectors, interactive apps, and open standards like the Model Context Protocol (MCP). We make plugins easy to discover, install, and use, ensure they’re invoked at the right time, and help people find new ways to get value from them.

We want anyone to be able to turn a useful workflow into a plugin, share it, and have other people use it. A plugin can package instructions and skills with connections to the tools and data it needs. Our work spans creation and publishing, reliable execution across our products, clear permissions and approvals, and the controls admins need to bring plugins to their organizations. We work closely with research to improve plugin quality as models evolve.

About the Role

We’re looking for product-minded engineers to build the systems behind plugins and improve how models use them. Depending on your focus, you may scale generalist infrastructure and identity-related integrations across products, or improve plugin quality at the intersection of backend engineering and applied AI or work on the product experience itself to drive plugin usage. You’ll work across teams and own problems from diagnosis and design through implementation and release.

This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

- Enjoy talking with users and developers, understanding what they’re trying to accomplish, and turning recurring problems into product and platform improvements.

- Can move between product questions and technical details, collaborate across teams, and take an ambiguous problem through to production.

- Are comfortable working across web interfaces and backend systems. Experience building applied AI systems, diagnosing model-tool interactions, and measuring reliability and quality is especially valuable.

- Have built products people rely on or software that other developers use, such as an API or SDK, an open-source project, a developer platform, or internal tools with real users.

title: Member of Technical Staff - Lead, Machines
description:
ABOUT US:

AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.

Our customers include category-defining companies like Lovable https://modal.com/blog/lovable-case-study, Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.

We recently raised a $355M Series C https://modal.com/blog/modal-series-c at a $4.65B valuation, led by General Catalyst and Redpoint Ventures. We've crossed $300M+ ARR and grown fivefold since September.

Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.

THE ROLE:

We are looking for a strong technical lead to guide the engineers designing, building, and maintaining the novel, high-performance systems that make up our serverless platform. You'll lead the team responsible for Modal's machines layer: the fleet of bare metal and cloud hosts that every Function, Sandbox, and training job runs on, and the control plane that provisions, images, monitors, and repairs them. You'll own the full lifecycle of a machine, from accepting and benchmarking new hardware from a growing set of providers, to network bring-up, kernel and image management, GPU and disk health tracking, and automated remediation of unhealthy hosts. You'll manage a team of 3-8 engineers while staying hands-on across the stack which involves BMCs, firmware, PXE, bootloaders, Linux networking, drivers, and distributed control-plane services, and you'll shape our long-term path further down the stack.

REQUIREMENTS:

- 7+ years of experience writing high-quality production code

- 3+ years of direct people management experience, ideally leading a team of engineers through project planning, growth, and performance conversations

- Experience operating large fleets of physical hardware at scale (bare metal provisioning, BMC/IPMI, PXE and network boot, firmware) or building the control planes that manage them (the more challenges you've worked through, the better)

- Strong cloud skills

- Strong knowledge of low-level operating system foundations (Linux kernel, drivers, networking, file systems, containers, etc.)

- Experience working with hardware and colocation providers, including hardware acceptance testing and benchmarking

- Track record of setting technical direction and driving architectural decisions across a team

- Willingness to step into the thick of it with our on-call rotation and respond to production incidents

NICE-TO-HAVES:

- Experience with GPUs and the NVIDIA software stack (drivers, health monitoring, RDMA/NVLink) in production

- Prior experience with Go

KEY THINGS THE TEAM IS WORKING ON:

- Automatic remediation of unhealthy machines (power cycling, reimaging, GPU recovery) to maximize uptime and minimize operator toil.

- Automatic integration of new CPU, GPU, and storage servers into the fleet while managing hardware and network heterogeneity.

- Network health monitoring and reliability across many datacenters, and standardization of bare metal network configuration.

- Automatic hardware acceptance testing and benchmarking (CPU, disk, GPU, interconnect, network).

- Custom network bootloader, machine image pipeline, and kernel and firmware management across the fleet.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
At SPD Technology , we bring together a team of like-minded people who are driven by the desire to bring value through their work, united in their commitment to high performance and delivering custom, cutting-edge tech solutions that drive clients’ growth. We empower our people with a culture of excellence and enable them with the opportunity to uphold their accountability to contribute on each level. We value humanity and collaboration, encourage professional and personal growth, and foster a supportive and flexible work environment where everyone’s contribution is welcomed.
And now we are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join us as part of our team.
About the role
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to lead the build of an automated payments reporting and analytics platform for a client in the payments space. Today, revenue reporting for this business depends on manual journal entries and manual assembly of results - the general ledger and BI reporting do not reconcile without human intervention, and reporting is too aggregated to explain performance.
Your mission is to replace that with a consistent, automated data flow: daily pipelines that land processor, CRM, and ERP data into a cloud data warehouse, post automatically to the general ledger, and feed a reporting layer granular enough to decompose any variance to budget down to its root cause. This is a high-ownership role with direct visibility to finance and business stakeholders, where the quality of your data models directly determines whether the business can trust its numbers.
Technical Stack
Core: Snowflake, dbt, SQL, Python, a modern orchestrator (Airflow / Dagster / Prefect), Git + CI/CD.
Source systems in scope: multiple payment processors and a core payments API, a CRM (customer & pricing attributes), and an ERP/general ledger. A BI tool renders the end-user dashboards on top of the modeled data.
As a qualified expert You will

• Design and build automated, reliable ELT pipelines that integrate data from multiple source systems (payment processors, CRM, and ERP) into a cloud data warehouse on a daily cadence.

• Automate financial reporting to the general ledger that reconciles with the reporting layer by design, replacing manual, error-prone processes.

• Build and maintain a data-mapping layer that resolves customer identity across systems and rolls transactions up to a single customer key.

• Model clean, well-documented data marts that make business performance explainable and support drill-down and variance analysis.

• Deliver the data models that power a KPI and forecasting dashboard for finance and business stakeholders.

• Ensure pipelines are robust and auditable with monitoring, data-quality checks, and alerting so issues are caught before reporting is consumed.

• Collaborate with BI, finance, and integration partners to turn business requirements into reliable data products and define phased delivery.

We’re looking for you if you have

• 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering, with a track record of owning production data pipelines end to end.

• Expert-level SQL - complex analytical queries, window functions, query optimization, and dimensional / star-schema data modeling.

• Hands-on experience on a modern cloud data warehouse, ideally Snowflake (or comparable: BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks).

• Strong experience with dbt (or an equivalent ELT transformation framework) for transformation and building tested, documented, version-controlled data models.

• Proven experience building and scheduling ELT/ETL pipelines using a workflow orchestrator (e.g. Airflow, Dagster, Prefect) and designing idempotent, re-runnable, incremental loads.

• Experience implementing data-quality testing, monitoring, and alerting as first-class parts of a pipeline.

title: Mental Health Therapist - Independently Licensed
description:
About NOCD
NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD , we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.
About the Role
As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD , we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.
NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists to join our team.
As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.
You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

• Manage your caseload and schedule

• Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system

• Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions
